jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the reference game sprite into ONE different full-body airborne jump pose for Sam Porter Bridges in our Death Stranding 2D fighting game. Identity, hood, face, navy courier suit, grey backpack cargo case, shoulder Odradek scanner, chest amber BB pod, straps and protective boots must stay consistent with the reference. Side view facing RIGHT, camera at torso height, no perspective foreshortening. Lift both feet completely off ground, forward knee raised to waist, rear lower leg folded backward, torso slightly leaning forward under the cargo weight, two gloved hands balanced in a compact guard. Clear natural silhouette with both boots visible, correct anatomy. Preserve the highly detailed hand painted 2D fighting sprite appearance and existing materials, with neutral lighting. The entire figure including scanner and backpack and boots inside canvas with at least 6% empty padding. Single character, single pose, no sheet, no duplicate. Output 1024x1536 portrait with a TRUE transparent background and clean alpha edges. Remove every background element: no backdrop, no gray halo, no smoke, no ground, no cast shadow, no vignette, no typography, no UI, no watermark. In particular all pixels outside the figure must be fully transparent.

Use case: stylized-concept. Using this reference game sprite as the exact visual design, create ONE full-body airborne jump pose for Fragile from Death Stranding in a 2D fighting game. Preserve face identity, short swept blonde hair, black glossy protective suit with small shoulder spines, black gloves and boots, folded black umbrella. Side profile facing RIGHT. At apex of a controlled forward jump: front knee bent and raised, back leg bent behind with both boots off the ground; free forward hand in a compact open guard, rear hand holds the folded umbrella behind and diagonally down, tip fully visible. Hair reacts subtly. Keep realistic anatomy and the same detailed painted 2D sprite style, neutral lighting. Entire figure, umbrella and boots fully inside canvas with 6% clear padding. One pose and one silhouette per image, no sheet or duplicate. 1024x1536 portrait on TRUE transparent background. No gray background or halo, no shadows, no smoke, no particles, no floor, no text, no watermark. Every pixel outside the character and umbrella fully transparent.

Use case: stylized-concept. Repose this exact MULE courier game sprite into ONE full-body airborne jump pose facing RIGHT for a side view 2D fighter. Full figure including pack, scanner and both boots inside canvas with at least 6% clear padding. ONE silhouette ONE pose, no sprite sheet. Portrait 1024x1536. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, clean alpha: no grey halo, no backdrop, no smoke, no vignette, no ground or cast shadow, no text, no logos added, no watermark.
